facts.text: Pellinore brings the tournament news to dinner.
facts.why: Pelinore arrives with news of the New Year's Day tournament while Ector's household settles in the dining hall after a meal.

facts.text: Ector's cup, filled once Merlin's blizzard ends.
facts.why: Merlin casts his indoor wizard blizzard over Ector, then stops it with Alakazam, so a cup filled once it ends is a fair menu joke.

facts.text: Wart, an education beats a sword any day. Now watch the dishes wash themselves.
facts.why: A note in Merlin's voice, not a quote. It fits the plot: Merlin's whole lesson is knowledge over strength, and he enchants the dishes to wash themselves while Wart is punished in the kitchen. Keep it without quote marks.

facts.text: Serve the mains when Merlin magics the castle dishes into washing themselves.
facts.why: Wart is sent to the kitchen as punishment and Merlin enchants the dishes to wash themselves. Matches.

vibe.verdict: A neat castle kitchen with the dishes, the fish and Merlin's note, but the poster sits in a tall black frame with empty bars and the wording is plain.
missing: Sugar bowl hopping about: 'Sugar? Sugar!' (Merlin's cottage)
Merlin packing everything into one suitcase (cottage)
Madam Mim as a dragon and Merlin as a germ (the duel)
Wart as a squirrel with the girl squirrel (forest)
ideas: Swap the sugar cubes line for 'Sugar? Sugar! Manners, guests first'
Rename 'Raspberry jam roly-poly' to 'Mim's mumps roll' with a germ duel note
Replace 'Moat fish bites' note with the angry pike
Crop the poster to fill its frame so the black bars go
